$schema: Directive lexicon for user prompts (RECEPTOR_PRECISION_GAPS §6). intents: canonical English terms grouped by intent — the only vocabulary the code knows. locales: translations registered per canonical term; every key must be a term listed under intents. segmentation: 'whitespace' matches on word boundaries, 'none' matches substrings (languages without spaces). Matches are logged as the canonical English term, whatever language the prompt was in.
